applied_settings: SPLIT-REGION CURVE - the configuration section 5.7.6 reports as best on this card, and which had never been stress-tested before this run. PROBED IMMEDIATELY BEFORE STARTING, not assumed: core clock at a locked 3090 target read 2975.9 MHz mean / 2977 max, which is the split signature (original tune reads ~2947, stock ~2610); memory clock under load read 16301 MHz, confirming the +2500 offset (stock is 13801). Curve shape per 5.7.6: stock voltage slope below ~845 mV, tuned flat shape 850-920 mV, top point 920 mV at 3000 MHz. Power limit 200W. Instant Replay OFF, encoder and decoder 0% at preflight. FIRST REAL STABILITY RUN IN THIS PROJECT.
duty_cycle_note: Load is not perfectly continuous. Each benchmark iteration is a separate Python process, so roughly 2 s of torch import and CUDA context creation sits between iterations. At these iteration counts that is about 3% of wall time, against 25% at the tool defaults. Read loaded_fraction in the logger's session JSON for the measured figure.
note: A clean run is not proof of stability. Undervolt failures routinely take hours to appear, and the degradation threshold is uncalibrated.
